_note: linked-case-with-a-role (C11, ADR-118). A case type declares the roles a case of it can be linked with, so a procedure that needs a linked case (an objection against a decision, an appeal after an objection) declares a role instead of shipping a class. RoleLinkDefinition is the single authority on the entry shape; this property only has to exist, because OpenRegister stores no undeclared key.

relations.title: Relation roles
relations.description: The roles a case of this type can be linked with. Each role says what it points at (another case, or an object that belongs to a case), the relation type it writes, whether intake needs it, and the record it opens.

label.description: What the role is called on screen.

target.description: Whether the role points at a case or at an object that belongs to a case.

targetSchema.description: Config key of the target schema, for a role that points at an object.

targetCaseField.description: The field on the target object that holds its case.

natureRelationship.description: The relation type written between the two cases.

requiredAtIntake.description: Whether intake needs this link before the case can proceed.

record.description: The record a link opens, when it opens one.

schema.description: Config key of the record schema.

actorField.description: Field that receives the acting user, when the record schema has one.
